explore-noon.title: When is it strongest?
explore-noon.prompt: Find the time of day when ionization is highest.
explore-noon.success: Midday: the sun is highest and ionization peaks.

explore-dawn.title: When is it weakest?
explore-dawn.prompt: Find the time of least ionization.
explore-dawn.success: Shortly before dawn: after a whole night without sunlight.

explore-split.title: Watch the F region split
explore-split.prompt: Move the clock into daytime and watch the F region.
explore-split.success: By day the F region splits into F1 and F2, and the D and E regions appear below.
